title: auth/smtp/integration tests cite external RFC oracles; never self-verify
description: auth/tests, smtp/tests, integration-tests: test vectors cite RFC 4616 §4 (SASL PLAIN), RFC 4122 (UUID), NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256). Tests cross-verify against published reference values, not against the implementation. This is exemplary test discipline. Do not replace with self-verifying roundtrip tests.
